limitations: This artifact retains waveform metrics and output hashes, not the audio/output arrays; this independent audit rechecks the recorded gates and identities without rerunning inference.
The passive worker follows the default worker on the same host. Cross-policy differences are descriptive; no randomized or counterbalanced experiment was run.
BENCH=1 callbacks synchronize individual graph nodes and change scheduling granularity. Nested operation and LSTM timers must not be added to the whole network time.

This tested commit records ldd, provider/build/thread strings, and built ggml library hashes, but not an in-process inventory of loaded DSO bytes or symbol-binding evidence. Exact OpenMP runtime binding is not established by the artifact.
Only small F16 waveform smoke is exercised; SCNet-large, all 35 intermediate stages, other quantizations, GPU, other-host performance, and held-out quality remain outside this run.
outcome: All recorded waveform gates pass; both default and passive native medians exceed their paired original medians. Passive waiting is slower for both engines in this sequential diagnostic.
